text:
elaine: Hey team — hawthorn (enterprise healthcare) wants to POC a custom fine-tuned Llama-3-14B variant. Need catalog onboarding + security signoff. Primary asks: compatibility with our runtime (HF safetensors/.pt), KV-cache and long-context (32k), recommended quantization for cost/latency, pricing for a 2-week POC at ~200 reqs/sec, and KMS/VPC requirements. Need an answer by EOD. @devon @maria

devon: Do we have the actual artifact? I need to know: model format (safetensors/pt), model_type (causal/decoder), tokenizer files, and declared context_length. Also: is this adapted with custom tokens? If it's HF-compatible we can run the compat scan. Example of the config we expect:
```json
{"model_type":"causal","context_length":32768,"vocab_size":50277}
```

maria: If this is chat-style traffic, KV-cache profiling is important. For ~200 rps with p99 <150ms we'd probably recommend Dedicated for the POC to be safe. Hosted can do a short burst but p99 will be higher. I can push a trial credit/temporary rate for 2 weeks.

samir: Quick infra checks: do they require BYOK? If yes, we need Dedicated or Private with customer-managed KMS + VPC. Also ask them to fill the security questionnaire — inbound/outbound, data residency, log retention. If they want VPC peering or private endpoint, that adds ~2–3 days on our side to set up for POC.

kevin: Catalog onboarding checklist (short): compatibility scan (model format + ops) -> perf bench (latency/throughput) -> quant profiling -> create variant entry -> QA tests (kv warmup, batching, fallback). Rough durations: compat 1–2d, perf 1d, quant 2–3d, QA 1–2d. Minimal POC (compat + perf) can be done in ~3 business days if artifacts are ready.

deploy-bot: Test deploy scheduled: hawthorn-poc-sanity v0.1 -> staging at 3502468120 :rocket:

elaine: Thanks. I'll tell the client we can start early next week. Sending artifact now: https://files.redwood.com/hawthorn/model-v1.safetensors (safetensors + tokenizer.zip).

devon: ETA: I'll run llm-compat-runner on the artifact and post results by Mon EOD. I will check context handling + KV-cache ops and attach perf logs.

samir: ETA: Security Q draft by Tue. Please send the client's questionnaire and BYOK details to security@redwood.com. If they insist on HSM we need legal signoff.

maria: Pricing (very rough): Hosted POC usage for 2 weeks ~$1.5k–$4k depending on tokens/throughput. Temporary Dedicated pool (prorated) could be ~ $8k–$15k for 2 weeks depending on GPU class (A10G vs H100). I'll get a firm quote by EOD.

kevin: I'll create a variant stub in the catalog and kick off automated compatibility tests. ETA for the stub: Wed. If we need the faster path, I can create a temporary "ad-hoc" variant for canary testing within 24–48h after compat results.

elaine: Great — owners confirmed. I'll update the customer. @devon @samir @maria @kevin :thumbsup:
